method: adapted from ChaiWithJai/aplus-video tools/design-review: capture atlas at two viewports, rectangle annotations with plain notes, failure-mode clustering, fix, recapture

annotations.note: 'Waiting to hear back' chip renders on the user's OWN outgoing card; server state says needsReply=false, direction=out — frontend-only leak
Dev strip overlaps the header/brand row on mobile
'Waiting to hear back' uses clay red — COPY.md reserves red for real problems the user must act on
Duration shown twice per card (meta line and right of waveform)
Header (app identity + E2EE lock chip, the trust cue) scrolled fully off-screen by window-level autoscroll; first paint is 40% blank
Entirely blank first paint at desktop — no header, no thread, no offline banner
Offline state shows neither the offline banner nor the queued bubble — the product thesis (offline still works) is invisible in the app built to prove it
Dev chip floats over card content mid-page
Fallback note 'I couldn't tidy this…' renders on a successful model clean (French card) — contradicts the sparkle mark on the same card
'Made on this phone' appears twice (header chip + per-card mark); per-card is the meaningful provenance
Dev chip overlaps header on mobile
bash "${3:-{}}" brace-default appended a stray } to every JSON body with an explicit arg
Malformed JSON body crashed the request thread (empty reply) instead of returning 400 — found when R1's mangled body hit the servers

layout-scroll-hijack.root_cause: window.scrollTo(0, scrollHeight) on render — scrolls the page, not the thread
layout-scroll-hijack.fix: thread scrolls in its own overflow container; header sticky; thread.scrollTop not window.scrollTo

state-leakage.root_cause: author display rules (.chip/.honest { display:flex }) silently defeat the hidden attribute — UA [hidden]{display:none} loses to any author display
state-leakage.fix: tokens.css: [hidden]{display:none !important} — kills the bug class platform-wide

dev-chrome-collision.root_cause: each app hand-placed its dev strip top-right over product chrome
dev-chrome-collision.fix: one shared convention: fixed bottom-left (above the dock where the dock is full-width), translucent

semantic-color-drift.fix: needs-reply chip moved from clay to wait palette per COPY.md rule 5

redundancy.fix: dropped duplicate duration and Bol's header provenance chip
